# Earned Escape

> Premium travel planning and advisory services for cruises and family vacations, operated by COTIB Adventures LLC and affiliated with Castle Dreams Travel.

Earned Escape is built on a lifetime of travel experience combined with 30 years of corporate IT systems engineering precision. We help families, couples, and milestone travelers plan effortless, elevated, and memorable vacations.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage (/)](https://earnedescape.agency/): Overview of services, personal travel story, and our interactive travel vibe selector.
- [About Us (/about)](https://earnedescape.agency/about): The COTIB Story. Founder Chuck Betancourt's background: traveling the world since age six, 30 years of corporate IT systems planning applied to travel, and the vision of COTIB Adventures LLC as a family legacy.
- [Plan Your Escape (/plan)](https://earnedescape.agency/plan): Book a free 30-minute Vacation Planning Call with Chuck via Google Calendar. Leads auto-ingest into Tern CRM.
- [Compliance (/compliance)](https://earnedescape.agency/compliance): Licensing, business registration (New Jersey), and official affiliate disclosures as an independent contractor of Castle Dreams Travel.

## Destinations & Planning Guides

- [Royal Caribbean (/royal-caribbean)](https://earnedescape.agency/royal-caribbean): Cruise planning shaped by firsthand sailings. Tips on stateroom selection, cruise classes, and itinerary planning.
- [Disney Cruise Line (/disney-cruise-line)](https://earnedescape.agency/disney-cruise-line): Family-first Disney Cruise Line planning. Details on ships (like the Disney Fantasy), onboard rotations, and honest comparisons with other cruise lines.
- [Walt Disney World (/disney-world)](https://earnedescape.agency/disney-world): Walt Disney World planning guide. Recommends a resort-first layout, rope drop strategies, selective Lightning Lane usage, and monorail resort insights.
- [Universal Orlando (/universal)](https://earnedescape.agency/universal): Vacation planning for Universal Orlando and the new Epic Universe theme park, featuring hotel recommendations and park strategy.
